# Description List

**Figma:** Description List (14859:79180) + .Primitives/Description-List/Item (14859:78890), page ❖ Description List (14857:3)  
**Import:** `import { DescriptionList, DescriptionItem } from "@zen-ds/react";`

Shows read-only term → value pairs in a semantic dl: order summaries and receipts, contact and profile details, specs and metadata.

## Use it for
- Order summaries, receipts and invoices, closed by one total row (emphasis).
- Contact, profile and account details, each row with an optional Edit or Copy action.
- Product specs and record metadata (IDs, dates, owners) in Cards, Side Panels and Bottom Sheets.

## Use something else for
- Records people compare, sort or select → Table.
- Rows people open or navigate to → List + ListItem.
- Editable forms → labelled fields (InputField, SelectField…); turn one row into a field only for a quick inline edit.
- One key number → Metric / MetricCard.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Layout | `layout` | inline (default: term at the start, value at the end; stacks by itself under stackBelow) · stacked (term above value) |
| Auto-stack width | `stackBelow` | px of the list's own width; default 280, so lists in phone cards and sheets stay inline; 0 never stacks |
| Divider Default (Pale) | `divider` | rules between rows, Padding/Small on both sides; never above the first or below the last row |
| Divider High + Body/Base/Bold | `items[].emphasis · <DescriptionItem emphasis>` | the total row: one per list, a High rule above it |
| Row action | `items[].action` | a Tertiary sm Button or a Flat sm IconButton; it takes room only in its own row (like an iOS accessory), so rows without one keep their value on the end edge |
| Rows | `items[] {id?, term, description, action?, emphasis?} · <DescriptionItem> children` | items render first |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/description-list.json`.

### DescriptionList
A semantic description list (dl) of term → description pairs: order summaries and receipts, profile details, specs and metadata. Figma: Description List (14859:79180, Layout × Divider, an Items slot) built from .Primitives/Description-List/Item (14859:78890, Layout × Emphasis × Divider, Term · Value · Action). Typography comes from the Figma text styles (term Body/Small/Regular Base, value Body/Base/Medium Strongest, total Body/Base/Bold); rules use Border/Neutral/Pale, and the total's rule Border/Neutral/Solid (Divider High). <DescriptionList items={[{ term: "Subtotal", description: "$311.90" }, { term: "Total", description: "$321.90", emphasis: true }]} />

Also accepts `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDListElement>, "children">`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `DescriptionListItem[]` | `[]` | The rows, in reading order. Or pass DescriptionItem children (both render, items first). |
| `layout` | `"inline" \| "stacked"` | `"inline"` | inline (default): term at the start and value at the end of one line (order summaries, specs); it stacks by itself when the list is narrower than `stackBelow`. stacked: term above value (profiles, addresses, long values). |
| `divider` | `boolean` | `false` | Pale rules (Border/Neutral/Pale) between rows, with Padding/Small above and below each rule. Default false. |
| `stackBelow` | `number` | `280` | Inline layout only: below this width (px) of the list itself the rows stack (term above value). Default 280, so lists in phone cards and sheets (about 300–350px) stay inline while narrow columns stack; 0 keeps them inline. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | — | DescriptionItem rows. |

### DescriptionItem
One row of a DescriptionList: a dt + dd group (plus a dd for the action). Use it only as a child of DescriptionList. <DescriptionItem term="Total" description="$321.90" emphasis />

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `term` (required) | `ReactNode` | — | The label (dt): Body/Small/Regular, Content/Neutral/Base. |
| `description` (required) | `ReactNode` | — | The value (dd): Body/Base/Medium, Content/Neutral/Strongest. |
| `action` | `ReactNode` | — | An action for this row only (rendered in its own dd at the end of the row). |
| `emphasis` | `boolean` | `false` | The total row: Body/Base/Bold with a High rule above it. One per list. |
| `className` | `string` | — | On the row's div (the dt/dd group). |

### Types
Object shapes the props above refer to.

```ts
interface DescriptionListItem { id?: string; term: ReactNode; description: ReactNode; action?: ReactNode; emphasis?: boolean; }
```

## ✅ Do
- Keep one end edge (user, 2026-10-04 / 10-06): every row ends on the list's end edge. A row action sits Gap/XSmall (8px) after its own value and takes room only in its row, as an iOS value cell with an accessory and Figma's Item (Content · Action): a row without an action keeps its value on the edge, so Copy on one DNS value next to Type and Host is fine. A Flat icon action lines its icon, not its 32px box, up with the edge. Amounts that add up to a total take no row actions (they must share one edge with the total): a one-off action there (remove a discount) is a removable Badge beside the term.
- Use inline for short values (amounts, dates, statuses) and layout="stacked" for long ones (addresses, emails, notes).
- Format every value for people: currency with its symbol, dates written out ("2 October 2026"), IDs as users see them.
- Close a calculation with one emphasis row, the total; the rows above it stay regular (harness: description-list/one-emphasis).
- Keep terms short nouns in a stable order across screens (Subtotal, Shipping, Tax, Total).
- Name row actions with their row: `Edit`<VisuallyHidden>` email`</VisuallyHidden>`` or `aria-label="Copy order number"`.
- Put the list inside a Card, Side Panel or Bottom Sheet body; it takes the container's width and stacks on its own when narrow.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't use it for data people scan across records or sort; use a Table.
- Don't emphasise more than one row, or colour values beyond a status (a positive discount, a negative balance).
- Don't add Divider elements inside the list; use divider (a dl only holds dt/dd groups).
- Don't give a row more than one action, or a Primary button.
- Don't truncate values; long values wrap, or use layout="stacked".

## Accessibility
- Renders a native dl with each dt/dd pair grouped in a div, so screen readers announce every term with its value.
- A row action sits in its own dd after the value; give it a name that includes the term.
- Announce copy and inline-edit results with a VisuallyHidden role="status" region.
- Never rely on colour alone: a discount keeps its minus sign, a status keeps its text.

## Content
- Terms are sentence-case nouns without colons ("Shipping address", not "Shipping Address:").
- Write "Free" or "None" when a value is legitimately empty; never leave it blank or use a dash.

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description-list/one-emphasis` | warn | One emphasised row per list: the total that closes the calculation. | `zen-allow-two-totals: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
